component.name: Qemux
component.summary: Create and launch QEMU virtual machines

description.p: Qemux is a lightweight manager for QEMU virtual machines. Create a VM from an ISO with a few sliders for CPU, RAM and storage, launch it with a click, and manage the underlying virtual disks — including reusing one already sitting on disk instead of creating a new one.

ul.li: Create, edit, launch and delete QEMU virtual machines
CPU, RAM and storage sliders with typeable exact values
Automatic OS icon detection from the chosen ISO's file name
A virtual disk browser showing which disks are in use
Reuse an existing unused disk instead of creating a new one
Keyboard shortcuts: Space to launch, E to edit, Delete to remove
